{{nihongo|'''Kisaki Shrine'''|后神社 (三宅村)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

'''Kisaki Shrine''' (きさきじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} on {{ill|Miyake-jima|ar|مياكي جيما|ast|Miyakejima|az|Miyakecima|ceb|Miyake Jima|cs|Mijakedžima|de|Miyake-jima|eo|Mijakeŝimo|es|Miyakejima|fa|میاکجیما|fr|Miyake-jima|it|Miyakejima|ja|三宅島|ko|미야케섬|lt|Mijakedžima|pnb|میاک-جیما|pt|Ilha Miyake|ru|Мияке (остров)|sk|Mijakedžima|sv|Miyakejima|th|เกาะมิยาเกะ|tl|Miyake, Tokyo|tr|Miyakejima|uk|Міяке (острів)|vi|Miyakejima|zh|三宅島|qid=Q1075076}} in {{ill|Miyake, Tokyo|ca|Miyake|es|Miyake (Tokio)|fa|میاکه، توکیو|fi|Miyake (Tokio)|fr|Miyake (Tokyo)|hy|Միյաքե (գյուղ)|id|Miyake, Tōkyō|it|Miyake (Tokyo)|ja|三宅村|ko|미야케촌|ru|Мияке (село)|th|มิยาเกะ (โตเกียว)|uk|Міяке (Токіо)|uz|Miyake (Tokio)|zh|三宅村|zh_yue|三宅村|qid=Q1154797}}, {{ill|Tokyo|Q1490|qid=Q1490}}.

It is enshrined directly in front of Igaya Port on the northwest side of Miyake-jima.

It is identified with '''Igamuhime-no-Mikoto Shrine''' (いかむひめのみことじんじゃ), a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}<ref name="kanko">[https://www.miyakejima.gr.jp/see/kisakijinja/ 后神社] - Miyakejima Tourism Association</ref><ref>[https://yaokami.jp/1131728/ 后神社] - Yaoyorozu no Kami</ref>.

It is one of three shrines on Miyake-jima that enshrine the consort of {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi}} (Mishima Daimyōjin)<ref>[https://www.vill.miyake.tokyo.jp/gyousei/syoukai/history.html 歴史] - Miyakejima, Tokyo</ref>.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* Igamuhime-no-Mikoto (いかむひめのみこと) - one of the consort deities of {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi}} (Mishima Daimyōjin).

According to mythology in ''Miyakeki'', the three sister-consorts of Mishima Daimyōjin (Kotoshironushi) enshrined at shrines on Miyake-jima were daughters of an elderly couple living around {{ill|Hakone|ja|箱根|qid=Q11603342}} and {{ill|Lake Ashi|ar|بحيرة أشي|arz|بحيره اشى|ceb|Ashino Ko|cv|Аси (кӳлĕ)|de|Ashi-See|el|Λίμνη Άσι|es|Lago Ashi|eu|Ashi aintzira|fa|دریاچه هاکونه|fi|Ashi|fr|Lac Ashi|he|אגם אשי|it|Lago Ashi|ja|芦ノ湖|ko|아시노호|mn|Аши нуур|ms|Tasik Ashi|my|အရှိကန်|pt|Lago Ashi|ru|Асиноко|sl|Aši (jezero)|th|ทะเลสาบอาชิ|tr|Ashi Gölü|zh|蘆之湖|qid=Q187053}}, rescued from a dragon deity (great serpent) and brought to Miyake-jima. The eldest daughter is Igamuhime-no-Mikoto of Kisaki Shrine, the second is Iwanohime-no-Mikoto of {{ill|Ninomiya Shrine (Q134930277)|Q134930277|qid=Q134930277|lt=Ninomiya Shrine}}, and the third is Sakitamahime-no-Mikoto of {{ill|Oshaku Shrine|Q110915859|qid=Q110915859}}<ref name="chosa-miyake">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz149900-01.html 三宅島の神社] - Study of Engishiki Shrines</ref>.
